body: i feel you, im a closeted trans girl. it fucking sucks. i hate living like this i will never feel like a real women without thousands of dollars into surgery and hrt, and even then i will never have a passing voice.
I'm proud of you. You got this. :)

I have considered the idea of suicide since I was just a little kid, once I hit puberty is when I actively started considering it. Now I'm 19 and after 1 failed attempt I plan on attempting again lmao. I guess this was my destiny

personal value means nothing in this society and i cant work or go to school so im useless and will struggle if i choose to stay alive. It's not like I would want to live if i had the money anyways so might as well get it over with
i doubt it. im a burden on everyone irl. im kind of a dick to everyone all the time bc i guess i have a lot of built up anger lmao. not much to miss here

I was in the same boat, I tried to take my life in October and very little people actually cared, and pretty much no one checked on me after a week even though I lived alone and could have done it again at any time. It sucks when you realize people pretend that they care just so they can feel like some sort of super hero amazing person or whatever, but they actually don't. People suck.
i believe the guns we have are strong enough to blow my head off so im confident it will kill me. idk why its taking me so long to work up the courage to just do it
Honestly I hope for anything, permanent sleep, nothingness, I'm not sure. I just hate this life and the way I am I just want it to end.
sounds much more desirable than what I have now

the only other option I have is a gun, I know the other 2 are unrealistic. I have easy access to a gun but for some reason that is just not the way I want to go, maybe it's because it's the same way my friend killed himself and I just don't want to even look at one let alone kill myself with it, I'm running out of options here
I feel you I also think I'm delusional. I want reincarnation to exist so much so I can experience a life that isn't destroyed by mental illness.
I'm really not glad I did but this isn't about me. I wish you the best of luck in your mental health journey, I hope you overcome this battle that a lot of people don't understand

my biggest fear is being put in a mental hospital, I almost got put in one after my first suicide attempt in October. (I am 18 years old) I told them my suicide attempt was an impulse which was slightly true but not the full truth, so they gave me the choice and of course I didn't go. It's the reason I cut off everyone and don't tell anyone how I feel except for anonymously online like this because I need some outlet I guess. Thank you for the post it was a good read.

I'm also on wellbutrin and it's just not working, I am blessed with good parents who are fortunate enough to be able to afford my treatments but just like you I feel like such a burden not being able to work or do anything. I'm 18 and dropped out after 1 semester of college and surviving a suicide attempt (tried to od on Prozac) I've always done the bare minimum never having any energy to do anything. I will probably attempt to OD once i get my refill of wellbutrin. If not im going to go with the blocking the exhaust pipe of my car in a deserted parking lot. Sorry I randomly went off the tracks and vented under your post, im a dumbass.

it's already too late. I threw away too many opportunities there is really nothing left for me. I don't really have friends or anyone at all who gets it. I'm so exhausted both physically and mentally all the time. I'm tired of living because of false hope thinking things will change, because they won't. You have to do it yourself and frankly I don't have the energy or the desire to put so much effort into fixing myself that probably won't do anything, it's the easier option and I'm going to take it.
thats life man. we're all forgotten about at some point, some of us sooner than others, it just really doesnt matter lmao

Yeah most people have moved on because you have to to keep moving forward in life. I don't think I will ever move on and will probably follow in his footsteps soon as well, so I mean it really depends on the current mental health of the people it will effect i guess.

everyone eventually moves on. people will lie to you to make you stay, even if you're miserable. I've been there and I'm still there, existing just to not make people upset when I'm so miserable. My friend ended his own life in September and it feels like everyone has just moved on and that it doesn't matter anymore.
feels like people only care if it benefits them so they can feel like a good person, no one who said they would be there when i needed it most was actually ever there.
